_comment: Live cases run against real PRs. Copy this to cases.live.json, fill in PRs
whose bugs you have personally verified, and run:
Do not guess the line numbers - open the PR's Files-changed tab and read
the number in the right-hand gutter. A wrong expectation scores a correct
review as a miss and sends you optimising the prompt in the wrong direction.

cases.name: example-live-case
cases.description: One sentence on what is wrong with this PR.
